title: I'm making a jet ski arcade racer for VR! Splash Rage VR is coming to Meta Quest 3
author: javiergame4
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on Splash Rage VR, a fast-paced jet ski arcade racing game for Meta Quest 3, and I'm excited to finally share it with you!

I've always loved classic arcade racers, and I wanted to bring that same excitement into VR. Think high-speed racing, massive jumps, sharp turns, and crazy water tracks across tropical islands, volcanic environments, and more.

My goal is to make something that feels like a classic arcade racer, but with the immersion and thrill that only VR can offer.

The game is getting close to release, and I'd really appreciate some honest feedback from the VR community!

What do you think of the gameplay and visuals? Does it look like something you'd enjoy playing? Is there anything you'd change or improve?

I'm still polishing things up before launch, so any constructive criticism or suggestions would mean a lot.

Splash Rage VR is coming soon to Meta Quest 3!

Thanks for checking it out!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/javiergame4, this falls under Rule 4. Commercial posts are okay here, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).
